by: Laptop session, pages loaded in Chrome on Blair's laptop
how_to_read: One entry per manager from the 'own site known' table in docs/LANDLORD-SOURCES.md. Keyed by manager name because the ids in collect/sources/landlords.json were not visible from the laptop. Field names follow LANDLORD-SOURCES.md. The values of data_access are this file's own words: json-api, html, html+json-ld, html-embedded-json. Units are registry units from LANDLORD-SOURCES.md.
not_done: No request was made from the VM. Whether a plain fetch gets the same answer is untested for every site.
robots.txt was read only on each landlord's own host, not on the API hosts (api.theliftsystem.com, lift-api.rentsync.com, website-gateway.rentsync.com, nestiolistings.com).
No site's terms of use were read.
Token and key values were deliberately not recorded. An adapter should read them from the page at run time.

managers.platform_evidence: Images from assets.rentsync.com/greenwin/. Site script is /scripts/main.js. Search page calls api.theliftsystem.com/v2/search. Suite markup uses classes suite, suite-type, suite-bath, suite-sqft, suite-rate, suite-availability.
managers.data_endpoint: https://api.theliftsystem.com/v2/search (query keys include client_id, auth_token, city_id, limit, offset, order, show_custom_fields). Returned a JSON array of 110 buildings, 41 with city Toronto.
managers.data_fields: Per building: id, name, permalink, address{address, city, postal_code}, geocode{latitude, longitude}, statistics.suites{rates{min,max}, bedrooms{min,max}, square_feet{min,max}}, matched_beds, availability_status, availability_count, min_availability_date.
managers.unit_level: unit type. The API is per building. The building page HTML has one row per suite type with baths, sqft, a 'FROM $X/mth' rent (rent_is_floor) and availability.
managers.notes: client_id and auth_token are supplied by the site's own script, not by an inline script on the page.

managers.platform_evidence: meta generator WordPress 7.0.7. Theme path /wp-content/themes/metcap/. Yoast robots block.
managers.data_endpoint: None carrying unit rows. /wp-json/wp/v2/apartment answers 200 with 346 items, but each has only slug, link and title (acf is empty). Useful as an index of unit-type pages; rents are in the HTML.
managers.unit_level: unit type. A property page at /property/<street-city-postal>/ has one table with a rent per unit type and links to /apartment/<type>-at-<address> pages. The address is in the page title and the URL.
managers.robots: 200. Yoast block, 'Disallow:' empty (everything allowed). Sitemap listed.
managers.notes: The province page showed no property links on first load; the property index was not found. The sitemap is the likely route.
